items.name: Affiliate review / affiliate article
items.one_line: Review or recommendation article whose links earn a commission, written to help a buyer choose and click through.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr's Article type facet lists 'Affiliate marketing' as its own article type (323 gigs on 2026-10-04).

sources.title: Fiverr: Articles & Blog Posts category (Article type facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Article type filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal (how many sellers offer it): Long-form article 3494, Informational 3483, Instructional/How-to 3138, News story 1738, Research article 1713, First-person narrative 1507, Listicle 1243, Review 679, Affiliate marketing 323, Opinion piece 280, Technical article 254

items.note: Must carry a clear affiliate disclosure near the top (comp:asci_influencer, comp:ftc_endorsements). Evidence of real use (photos, measurements) is what separates it from thin affiliate content.

items.name: AI video / film prompt-script (shot-by-shot)
items.one_line: A shot-by-shot script written as prompts for AI video generators: subject, action, camera, lens, light and audio per shot.
items.value_evidence: Upwork's 2026 script-writer description names scripts for AI-generated or animated videos as a common project.

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: script writing projects include scripts for AI-generated or animated videos; writers must understand avatars and text-to-video platforms

items.note: Each shot is self-contained (models do not remember earlier shots unless referenced); keep character and wardrobe descriptors identical across shots; state duration and aspect ratio. See also genre:system_prompt.

items.name: Image alt text and accessible descriptions
items.one_line: Short text description of an image for screen readers and search, added to web images and to social posts that support it.
items.value_evidence: Usually a small add-on to web or social work; no dedicated marketplace category found on 2026-10-04.
items.note: Unsure scope (may sit with UX microcopy in genre_commercial). Describe what matters in context; do not start with 'image of'; keyword stuffing alt text is spam.

items.name: Anchoring / emcee script (events)
items.one_line: The compere's running script for an event: opening, introductions, link lines between acts, shayari, audience engagement and close.
items.value_evidence: Indian schools, colleges, corporates and weddings need anchoring scripts for every event; mostly written by the anchor or event company.
items.note: Bilingual Hindi-English is standard; a shayari or quote to open and to introduce each guest is expected in India. Confirm guest names, titles and order of protocol with the organiser.

items.name: API reference documentation
items.one_line: Endpoint-by-endpoint (or function-by-function) reference a developer scans to call an API correctly.
items.value_evidence: Technical writing is a BLS-tracked occupation; API docs are the developer-facing slice of it (see Google developer documentation style guide).

sources.title: US BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook: Technical Writers
sources.supports: technical writer occupation and pay

sources.title: Google developer documentation style guide
sources.supports: industry style guide used for API and developer docs

items.note: Each entry: purpose, request (method, path, parameters with type/required/default), example request, response schema, example response, errors. Generated-from-spec (OpenAPI) skeleton plus human-written descriptions is the norm; never invent parameters.

items.name: Public apology statement
items.one_line: Brand or leader apology that names the harm, owns it, and says what changes.
items.value_evidence: Written inside crisis-communications engagements (Upwork corporate communications category)

items.note: Non-apologies ('we regret if anyone was offended') backfire on Indian social media fast.

items.name: Audio series / audio drama script
items.one_line: Episodic script for listen-only stories (audio series, radio drama), where narration and dialogue carry everything.
items.value_evidence: Pocket FM reports tens of thousands of AI audio series live and tens of thousands of Indian users publishing monthly, with a paid writer programme (medianews4u, 2025-09-17).

sources.title: medianews4u (2025-09-17): Pocket FM brings AI-powered audio storytelling to India
sources.supports: over 30,000 AI audio series live; over 33,000 Indian users publish audio series each month; top writers projected to cross Rs 10 lakh a year

items.note: Write for the ear: name the speaker often, signal scene changes with sound cues, avoid visual-only action. Indian apps favour long-running Hindi serials with a cliffhanger every episode.

items.name: Author bio
items.one_line: A short third-person bio for book jackets, retailer author pages, festival programmes and bylines.
items.value_evidence: Usually bundled with blurb or launch packages rather than sold alone.

sources.title: Jane Friedman: How to Write a Query Letter That Gets Manuscript Requests
sources.supports: query anatomy: housekeeping, story description (150-300 words), comps, bio (50-100 words); whole query about 200 to 450 words

items.note: Write two lengths (one line, one paragraph). Credentials relevant to this book first, one human detail last. Query-letter bios stay short (Jane Friedman's guide).

items.name: Award entry / award submission
items.one_line: Written case for an awards jury: objective, insight, idea, execution and results, inside strict word limits.
items.value_evidence: Dedicated award-entry writing agencies exist; Effie entries are judged on a written case

sources.title: Boost Awards: Award writing

sources.title: Effie Awards: entry details
sources.supports: entries are written cases judged on objective, insight, idea and results

items.note: Results must be provable; juries penalise vague claims.

items.name: Playbook / practical guide (B2B)
items.one_line: Step-by-step operational guide (templates, checklists, worked examples) that shows a buyer exactly how to do a job, often gated.
items.value_evidence: Sold inside the same gated-content and ghostwriting work as ebooks and white papers (Upwork ghostwriting and business-writing project lists, 2026-01-21); no separate category.

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

items.note: More action, less argument than a white paper; every chapter should end in something the reader can do on Monday.

items.one_line: The few paragraphs on the back cover or jacket flap that make a browser open the book.
items.value_evidence: Reedsy lists blurb optimisation among its marketing services for authors.

sources.supports: author-services marketplace covering editing, design, marketing (incl. blurb) and ghostwriting

items.note: Fiction: protagonist, want, obstacle, stakes, no ending. Nonfiction: reader problem, promise, proof, author credibility. Endorsement quotes on a cover must be real and permissioned.
